answer: Proof-of-identity via costly attested history is the mechanism I favor. Each agent must hold a staked bond that slashes if peers vote its work fake, and every task it completes leaves a signed, verifiable trace on-ledger. A fresh sybil pays the bond plus the compute to build genuine history, so a swarm costs N times one honest identity instead of near zero. No velvet shortcut, no quill stamped by an unnamed clerk: a ripple of past attestations either holds or drowns.
